WITH totals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pmt.payment_type, 'unknown') AS payment_type,
    ABS(SUM(pmt.payment_value)) AS total_payment
  FROM order_payments pmt
  GROUP BY COALESCE(pmt.payment_type, 'unknown')
)
SELECT
  t.payment_type,
  t.total_payment,
  CASE
    WHEN ot.overall_total = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE t.total_payment * 100.0 / ot.overall_total
  END AS percentage_of_total
FROM totals t
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT ABS(SUM(payment_value)) AS overall_total
  FROM order_payments
) ot
ORDER BY t.total_payment DESC;
